_meta.description: EVAL-1 golden set: real, objectively-resolved binary (YES/NO) questions from 2024-2025 used to characterize whether pipeline changes make FORECASTS better (not just tests green). Each entry is a genuinely resolved, checkable event. 'resolved_outcome' is the ground-truth YES(true)/NO(false). Score a pipeline's binary_forecasts (matched by id) against this file with backend/scripts/golden_eval.py; audit it with backend/scripts/golden_curate.py audit.
_meta.outcome_semantics: resolved_outcome=true  → the event described by 'question' HAPPENED (YES). resolved_outcome=false → it did NOT happen (NO). A forecast's 'probability' is the model's YES probability in [0,1].
_meta.as_of_semantics: 'as_of_date' is the forecast origin (end of day UTC) a replay is framed at, not a model knowledge cutoff: every question resolved before current model cutoffs. A fair as-of replay is impossible until point-in-time research exists (research reads the live web), so every score on this set is characterization only (ADR 0002 I-21).
_meta.visible_text_rule: Only app.services.golden_set.forecaster_view(q) (exactly id, question, resolution_criteria, as_of_date) may enter a replay brief, probe or prompt. resolution_criteria is one outcome-free sentence starting 'YES if'; outcome prose lives in resolution_note; every parenthetical in question or criteria is listed verbatim in reviewed_parentheticals.
_meta.event_cluster_rule: Questions about one underlying event share an event_cluster: both sides of one election (us-pres-2024, us-senate-2024, uk-ge-2024, in-ge-2024) and the four linked FOMC decisions (fomc-2024-25); every other question is its own cluster (23 clusters). Bootstrap CIs resample whole clusters.
_meta.verification_rule: 'legacy_unverified' rows carry no resolution_evidence (no source URLs were invented): their resolved_outcome is asserted, not recomputed, until a human adds evidence and sets verification 'verified'. resolve_time is resolution_date at end of day UTC (resolve_time_precision 'day').

questions.question: Will Donald Trump win the 2024 US presidential election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if Donald Trump is certified as winner with >=270 electoral votes per the official 2024 Electoral College result.

questions.question: Will Kamala Harris win the 2024 US presidential election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if Kamala Harris is certified as winner with >=270 electoral votes per the official 2024 Electoral College result.

questions.question: Will Republicans win a majority of seats in the US Senate in the 2024 election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the Republican caucus holds >=51 Senate seats after the 2024 general election.

questions.question: Will Democrats retain control of the US Senate after the 2024 election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the Democratic caucus holds >=50 seats (with VP tiebreak) after the 2024 election.

questions.question: Will the Labour Party win the most seats in the 2024 UK general election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if Labour wins a plurality of House of Commons seats in the July 2024 UK general election.

questions.question: Will the Conservative Party win the most seats in the 2024 UK general election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the Conservatives win a plurality of House of Commons seats in July 2024.

questions.question: Will the National Rally (RN) win an absolute majority in the 2024 French National Assembly election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if RN and allies win >=289 of 577 seats in the July 2024 snap legislative election.
questions.resolution_note: They finished third; no absolute majority.

questions.question: Will Claudia Sheinbaum win the 2024 Mexican presidential election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if Claudia Sheinbaum wins the June 2, 2024 Mexican presidential election per the official INE count.

questions.question: Will Prabowo Subianto win the 2024 Indonesian presidential election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if Prabowo Subianto wins the February 2024 Indonesian presidential election outright in the first round (>50%).

questions.question: Will the BJP win an outright majority (272+ seats) on its own in the 2024 Indian Lok Sabha election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the BJP alone wins >=272 of 543 Lok Sabha seats.
questions.resolution_note: It won 240 and needed NDA allies for a majority.

questions.question: Will the BJP-led NDA coalition win a majority in the 2024 Indian general election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the NDA coalition wins >=272 of 543 Lok Sabha seats.

questions.question: Will Apple announce the iPhone 16 lineup in September 2024?
